name: item-in-water
comment: WP-2.1. A still-water pool (id 9) two deep at (-1..1, 59..60, -1..1) cut into the stone platform, stone under and around it. Item 0 (cobblestone) falls from (0.5, 66, 0.5) with zero motion: on the tick it enters the water Entity.onEntityUpdate plays the splash and spawns bubble and splash particles from Entity.rand (Entity.java:205-236; EntityItem.handleWaterMovement tests the whole box, EntityItem.java:79-81), then it sinks to the floor. Item 1 starts inside the water at (0.5, 59.5, -0.5): it is in water on its first update (isFirstUpdate, so no splash). entity_state and rng_state every tick.
